import copy
import hashlib
import json
import os
import pathlib
import sys
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
import uuid

ORIGIN = "http://symmetry-0009-control:4009"
TOKEN = os.environ["SYMMETRY_OPERATOR_TOKEN"]
OUT = pathlib.Path("/out/acceptance-final.json")
PROJECT = "139a5747-5878-4503-9972-1bd3a46b9400"
RESOURCE = "eb968617-36be-48ce-8321-b6b20f7ce77f"
state = json.loads(OUT.read_text()) if OUT.exists() else {"observations": []}


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def save():
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")


def digest(value):
    encoded = json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).encode()
    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()


def api(method, path, body=None, label=None, token=TOKEN):
    headers = {"authorization": "Bearer " + token, "content-type": "application/json"}
    request = urllib.request.Request(ORIGIN + path, headers=headers, method=method,
                                    data=None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode())
    try:
        response = urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=20)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        response = error
    raw = response.read(16 * 1024 * 1024 + 1)
    require(len(raw) <= 16 * 1024 * 1024, "bounded HTTP response exceeded")
    result = json.loads(raw)
    if label:
        state["observations"].append({"label": label, "method": method, "path": path,
                                      "request": body, "status": response.status, "response": result})
        save()
        print(label + ": HTTP " + str(response.status), flush=True)
    return response.status, result


def goal(goal_id):
    status, value = api("GET", "/api/v1/goals/" + goal_id)
    require(status == 200, "goal read failed")
    return value


def command(goal_id, kind, payload, label, expected=200):
    current = goal(goal_id)
    body = {"schema_version": "symmetry.goal_command.v1", "mutation_id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
            "expected_version": current["version"], "expected_revision": current["current_revision"],
            "kind": kind, "payload": payload}
    status, value = api("POST", "/api/v1/goals/" + goal_id + "/commands", body, label)
    if status == 409 and value.get("error", {}).get("code") == "stale":
        refreshed = goal(goal_id)
        require(refreshed["current_revision"] == body["expected_revision"], "Goal revision changed during witness command")
        body = dict(body, mutation_id=str(uuid.uuid4()), expected_version=refreshed["version"])
        status, value = api("POST", "/api/v1/goals/" + goal_id + "/commands", body, label + "-after-version-refresh")
    require(status == expected, label + ": unexpected HTTP status")
    return body, value


def refusal(goal_id, payload, label, code):
    status = 409 if code == "invalid_decision" else 422
    _, value = command(goal_id, "achieve", payload, label, status)
    require(value["error"]["code"] == code, label + ": refusal code differs")


def until(read, predicate, label, seconds=240):
    deadline = time.monotonic() + seconds
    while True:
        value = read()
        if predicate(value):
            state[label] = value
            save()
            return value
        require(time.monotonic() < deadline, label + ": observation deadline expired")
        time.sleep(1)


def acceptance(operator=False):
    predicates = [{"id": "readme", "kind": "artifact", "resource_id": RESOURCE, "path": "README.md"}]
    if operator:
        predicates.append({"id": "operator", "kind": "operator_acceptance"})
    return {"schema_version": "symmetry.acceptance.v1", "description": "Verify committed README at the exact Subject.",
            "predicates": predicates}


def create(title):
    result = {"schema_version": "symmetry.task_result.v1", "result_id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
              "kind": "candidate_completion", "summary": "Read committed README.md and verified the requested artifact.",
              "subject": state["subject"], "subject_hash": digest(state["subject"]), "evidence_refs": [],
              "blocker": None, "proposed_next_action": None, "proposal": None, "reason": None, "diagnostics": []}
    objective = ("Perform exactly one read-only repository task. Use the real read tool to read README.md. "
                 "Do not write files, execute commands, delegate, access credentials, commit, publish, or accept a Goal. "
                 "If and only if the real read succeeds, return this candidate TaskResult as the entire final JSON: "
                 + json.dumps(result) + ". If the real read fails, return a truthful failed TaskResult, not the example candidate.")
    body = {"schema_version": "symmetry.goal_create.v1", "mutation_id": str(uuid.uuid4()), "title": title,
            "initial_revision": {"objective": objective, "non_goals": ["No repository mutation", "No publication"],
                "acceptance_contract": acceptance(True),
                "authority_policy": {"operator_required_for_scope_change": True, "operator_required_for_completion": True,
                                     "publication_allowed": False, "allowed_actions": []},
                "execution_policy": {"automatic_execution": False, "max_parallel_tasks": 1,
                    "max_task_admissions": 3, "max_run_attempts_per_task": 1, "budget_limit_microusd": None,
                    "per_run_cost_limit_microusd": None, "budget_mode": "soft", "hard_cost_limit_required": False,
                    "allowed_runtime_ids": [state["runtime_id"]], "allowed_model_profiles": ["omo"],
                    "final_acceptance": "operator", "allowed_actions": [], "allowed_resource_ids": [RESOURCE]},
                "context_manifest": {"byte_budget": 32768, "required_source_kinds": ["repository", "approved_goal", "work_contract"],
                                     "include_advisory_recall": False}, "reason": "Owner-requested local amendment acceptance"}}
    status, value = api("POST", "/api/v1/projects/" + PROJECT + "/goals", body, title)
    require(status == 201, "goal creation failed")
    return value["goal"]["id"]


def item(key, required):
    return {"key": key, "title": key, "description": "Read and independently validate the committed README; no repository changes.",
            "required": required, "repository_resource_id": RESOURCE, "acceptance": acceptance(),
            "depends_on_keys": [], "model_profile": "omo", "baseline": {"kind": "subject", "subject": state["subject"]},
            "change_target": None}


def proposal(goal_id, items):
    return {"schema_version": "symmetry.plan.v1", "proposal_id": str(uuid.uuid4()), "goal_id": goal_id,
            "expected_revision": 1, "items": items}


def approve_plan(goal_id, plan, label):
    payload = {"kind": "plan", "work_item_id": None, "subject_hash": None, "proposal": plan}
    _, requested = command(goal_id, "request_decision", payload, label + "-request")
    decision_id = requested["response"]["decision"]["id"]
    command(goal_id, "resolve_decision", {"decision_id": decision_id, "expected_decision_version": 1, "option_id": "accept"}, label + "-resolve")
    canonical = copy.deepcopy(plan)
    for entry in canonical["items"]:
        entry.setdefault("integration", False)
    body, admitted = command(goal_id, "accept_plan", {"proposal": plan, "proposal_hash": digest(canonical), "decision_id": decision_id}, label + "-admit")
    status, replay = api("POST", "/api/v1/goals/" + goal_id + "/commands", body, label + "-replay")
    require(status == 200 and replay == admitted, "plan replay changed its receipt")
    return decision_id


def admit(goal_id, item_id, purpose, label, producer=None):
    _, receipt = command(goal_id, "admit_task", {"work_item_id": item_id, "purpose": purpose, "model_profile": "omo",
        "session_mode": "fresh", "requested_session_id": None, "validation_of_task_id": producer}, label)
    return receipt["response"]["task"]["id"]


def refuse_plan_admission(goal_id, plan, decision_id, label):
    command(goal_id, "resolve_decision", {"decision_id": decision_id, "expected_decision_version": 1,
        "option_id": "accept"}, label + "-resolve")
    canonical = copy.deepcopy(plan)
    for entry in canonical["items"]:
        entry.setdefault("integration", False)
    _, rejected = command(goal_id, "accept_plan", {"proposal": plan, "proposal_hash": digest(canonical),
        "decision_id": decision_id}, label + "-admission", 422)
    require(rejected["error"]["code"] == "invalid_plan", label + ": admission refusal differs")


def prepare():
    require("goal_id" not in state, "prepare already produced a goal; recover its receipt instead")
    state["subject"] = json.loads(os.environ["SUBJECT_JSON"])
    status, runtimes = api("GET", "/api/v1/runtimes", label="registered-runtimes")
    require(status == 200, "runtime projection failed")
    matches = [r for r in runtimes["runtimes"] if r["runtime_key"] == "accept-0009-omo"]
    require(len(matches) == 1, "run-owned runtime is not uniquely registered")
    state["runtime_id"] = matches[0]["runtime_id"]
    save()
    goal_id = create("0009 real single-required operator achieve")
    state["goal_id"] = goal_id
    save()
    status, _ = api("GET", "/api/v1/goals/" + goal_id, label="invalid-credential-refused", token="invalid-0009-token")
    require(status == 401, "operator authentication boundary was not enforced")
    plan = proposal(goal_id, [item("optional-before", False), item("required-readme", True), item("optional-after", False)])
    state["original_proposal"] = copy.deepcopy(plan)
    save()
    state["plan_decision_id"] = approve_plan(goal_id, plan, "single-plan")
    projected = goal(goal_id)
    state["admitted_projection"] = projected
    state["required_item_id"] = next(i["id"] for i in projected["work_items"] if i["title"] == "required-readme")
    state["optional_item_id"] = next(i["id"] for i in projected["work_items"] if i["title"] == "optional-before")
    require(next(i for i in projected["work_items"] if i["id"] == state["required_item_id"])["integration"], "sole required role was not derived")
    command(goal_id, "activate", {"approved_revision": 1}, "single-activate")
    refusal(goal_id, {"subject": state["subject"], "evidence_ids": [], "decision_id": None}, "missing-required-outcome", "incomplete_work")
    state["producer_task_id"] = admit(goal_id, state["required_item_id"], "implement", "admit-real-native-producer")
    state["stage"] = "producer_admitted"
    save()


def validate():
    require(state["stage"] == "producer_admitted", "producer stage differs")
    def read_task():
        status, task = api("GET", "/api/v1/tasks/" + state["producer_task_id"])
        require(status == 200 and task["state"] not in ["failed", "cancelled"], "real native producer failed")
        return task
    until(read_task, lambda task: task["state"] == "completed", "real_producer")
    state["validation_task_id"] = admit(state["goal_id"], state["required_item_id"], "validate", "admit-independent-artifact-validator", state["producer_task_id"])
    state["stage"] = "validation_admitted"
    save()


def probe():
    require(state["stage"] == "validation_admitted", "validation stage differs")
    goal_id = state["goal_id"]
    if "optional_probe_task_id" in state:
        status, task = api("GET", "/api/v1/tasks/" + state["optional_probe_task_id"])
        require(status == 200 and task["state"] == "queued", "saved optional probe is no longer undispatched")
        ready = goal(goal_id)
        outcome = next(o for o in ready["accepted_outcomes"] if o["work_item_id"] == state["required_item_id"])
        payload = {"subject": state["subject"], "evidence_ids": outcome["evidence_ids"], "decision_id": None}
        refusal(goal_id, payload, "nonterminal-optional-task-resumed", "nonterminal_task")
        state.setdefault("driver_recoveries", []).append({"failure": state.pop("failure", None),
            "resolution": "Preserved the observed stale refusal, refreshed the same Goal revision, and resumed only the undispatched optional-task refusal; no admission was repeated."})
        state["stage"] = "optional_probe_admitted"
        save()
        return
    ready = until(lambda: goal(goal_id), lambda value: bool(value["accepted_outcomes"]), "independently_accepted")
    outcome = next(o for o in ready["accepted_outcomes"] if o["work_item_id"] == state["required_item_id"])
    require(outcome["candidate_subject"] == state["subject"], "accepted Subject differs")
    payload = {"subject": state["subject"], "evidence_ids": outcome["evidence_ids"], "decision_id": None}
    conflict = dict(payload, integration_work_item_id=state["optional_item_id"])
    refusal(goal_id, conflict, "conflicting-integration-payload", "integration_outcome_required")
    mismatch = copy.deepcopy(payload)
    mismatch["subject"]["tree_digest"] = "sha256:" + "0" * 64
    refusal(goal_id, mismatch, "integration-subject-mismatch", "integration_outcome_required")
    _, scope = command(goal_id, "request_decision", {"kind": "scope", "work_item_id": state["required_item_id"],
        "subject_hash": None, "proposal": {"kind": "add_dependency", "depends_on_id": state["optional_item_id"]}}, "open-unrelated-scope-decision")
    decision_id = scope["response"]["decision"]["id"]
    refusal(goal_id, payload, "unresolved-decision", "unresolved_decision")
    command(goal_id, "resolve_decision", {"decision_id": decision_id, "expected_decision_version": 1, "option_id": "reject"}, "reject-unrequested-dependency")
    optional_task = admit(goal_id, state["optional_item_id"], "implement", "queue-optional-without-dispatch")
    state["optional_probe_task_id"] = optional_task
    save()
    refusal(goal_id, payload, "nonterminal-optional-task", "nonterminal_task")
    state["stage"] = "optional_probe_admitted"
    save()


def finish():
    require(state["stage"] == "optional_probe_admitted", "optional probe stage differs")
    goal_id = state["goal_id"]
    def read_optional_task():
        status, task = api("GET", "/api/v1/tasks/" + state["optional_probe_task_id"])
        require(status == 200, "optional probe task read failed")
        return task
    optional = until(read_optional_task, lambda task: task["state"] in ["completed", "failed", "cancelled"], "optional_probe_terminal")
    print("optional-probe-terminal: " + optional["state"], flush=True)
    ready = goal(goal_id)
    outcome = next(o for o in ready["accepted_outcomes"] if o["work_item_id"] == state["required_item_id"])
    require(outcome["candidate_subject"] == state["subject"], "accepted Subject changed after optional probe")
    payload = {"subject": state["subject"], "evidence_ids": outcome["evidence_ids"], "decision_id": None}
    if "multi_goal_id" not in state:
        state["multi_goal_id"] = create("0009 multi-required explicit obligations")
        save()
    multi_id = state["multi_goal_id"]
    if not state.get("multi_missing_marker_refused"):
        existing = next((o for o in state["observations"] if o["label"] == "multi-missing-designation" and o["status"] == 200), None)
        if existing:
            multi = existing["request"]["payload"]["proposal"]
            decision_id = existing["response"]["response"]["decision"]["id"]
        else:
            multi = proposal(multi_id, [item("multi-one", True), item("multi-two", True)])
            _, requested = command(multi_id, "request_decision", {"kind": "plan", "work_item_id": None,
                "subject_hash": None, "proposal": multi}, "multi-missing-designation")
            decision_id = requested["response"]["decision"]["id"]
        refuse_plan_admission(multi_id, multi, decision_id, "multi-missing-designation")
        state["multi_missing_marker_refused"] = True
        save()
    multi = proposal(multi_id, [item("multi-one", True), item("multi-two", True)])
    multi["items"][0]["integration"] = True
    foreign_decision = approve_plan(multi_id, multi, "multi-explicit-plan")
    command(multi_id, "activate", {"approved_revision": 1}, "multi-activate")
    _, missing_payload = command(multi_id, "achieve", payload, "multi-missing-integration-payload", 400)
    require(missing_payload["error"]["code"] == "invalid_request", "multi-required payload refusal differs")
    refusal(goal_id, dict(payload, decision_id=foreign_decision), "foreign-plan-authority-decision", "invalid_decision")
    _, reviewed = command(goal_id, "request_decision", {"kind": "review", "work_item_id": state["required_item_id"],
        "subject_hash": digest(state["subject"]), "proposal": None}, "primary-work-item-review-request")
    review_decision = reviewed["response"]["decision"]["id"]
    command(goal_id, "resolve_decision", {"decision_id": review_decision, "expected_decision_version": 1,
        "option_id": "accept"}, "primary-work-item-review-resolve")
    refusal(goal_id, dict(payload, decision_id=review_decision), "work-item-review-cannot-authorize-goal-achieve", "invalid_decision")
    conflict_id = create("0009 conflicting single-required designation")
    state["conflict_goal_id"] = conflict_id
    save()
    conflicting = proposal(conflict_id, [item("optional-conflict", False), item("required-conflict", True)])
    conflicting["items"][0]["integration"] = True
    _, conflicting_marker = command(conflict_id, "request_decision", {"kind": "plan", "work_item_id": None, "subject_hash": None,
        "proposal": conflicting}, "single-conflicting-designation")
    refuse_plan_admission(conflict_id, conflicting, conflicting_marker["response"]["decision"]["id"], "single-conflicting-designation")
    ready = until(lambda: goal(goal_id), lambda value: value["completion"]["ready?"], "pre_achieve_readiness")
    require("achieve" in ready["allowed_actions"], "ready operator was not offered achieve")
    require(not any(d["kind"] == "completion" for d in ready["decisions"]), "self completion decision was created")
    require("final_acceptance_required" not in json.dumps(ready), "phantom completion blocker remains")
    status, attention = api("GET", "/api/v1/attention?limit=100", label="pre-achieve-attention")
    entry = next(e for e in attention["entries"] if e["goal_id"] == goal_id)
    require(status == 200 and entry["ready_to_achieve?"], "attention is not directly ready")
    require("final_acceptance_required" not in json.dumps(entry), "attention retains phantom completion")
    body, achieved = command(goal_id, "achieve", payload, "operator-achieve-no-completion-decision-no-integration-id")
    status, replay = api("POST", "/api/v1/goals/" + goal_id + "/commands", body, "achieve-identical-replay")
    require(status == 200 and replay == achieved, "achieve replay changed mutation receipt")
    final = goal(goal_id)
    require(final["state"] == "achieved", "goal is not achieved")
    status, events = api("GET", "/api/v1/goals/" + goal_id + "/events", label="achieved-event-readback")
    achieved_events = [e for e in events["entries"] if e["kind"] == "achieve"]
    require(status == 200 and len(achieved_events) == 1 and achieved_events[0]["actor_ref"] == "operator", "achieved event was missing or duplicated")
    state["final_projection"] = final
    if "failure" in state:
        state.setdefault("driver_recoveries", []).append({"failure": state.pop("failure"),
            "resolution": "Proposal request is not plan admission; reused its recorded decision, observed invalid_plan at accept_plan, and continued without repeating native work."})
    state["stage"] = "achieved_awaiting_owner_verdict"
    save()


try:
    {"prepare": prepare, "validate": validate, "probe": probe, "finish": finish}[sys.argv[1]]()
except Exception as error:
    state["failure"] = {"type": type(error).__name__, "detail": str(error)}
    save()
    raise
print(json.dumps({"stage": state.get("stage"), "goal_id": state.get("goal_id"), "receipt": str(OUT)}))
